Taxes and fees at Anaheim hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($23 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Howard Johnson by Wyndham Fullerton Anaheim Conference Cntr to 17% at Sonesta Anaheim Resort Area. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
